Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Contemporary Geometric Area Rug, 5' 11" x 3' 11", White
Colors: White
Geometric patterns against an ivory background will bring a modern global flair to your home. Offered in a variety of colors that will blend with most any room, the soft design is accented by light fringe. 5' 11" x 3' 11" Medium-high pile is soft and easy to clean Pair with rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
